meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图对比，并检查设计系统、功能正确性和文字显示，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了任何网页界面或终端界面，并准备宣布完成时触发。也适用于你怀疑界面有回归问题、文字显示异常或布局错位时。

say.text: 检查我刚改好的这个页面布局对不对。
看看这个终端界面有没有文字溢出或边框错位。
say.note: Claude 会捕获终端渲染结果，检查宽度和边框对齐。

say.text: 验证这个组件是否符合设计系统的颜色和间距规范。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA on any UI you build or modify. It captures screenshots, compares them with references, and checks design system integrity, functionality, and CJK text rendering, then outputs a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after building or changing any web or terminal UI, before declaring it done. Also when you suspect regressions, text clipping, or layout misalignment.

say_en.text: Check the layout of this page I just modified.
say_en.note: Claude will capture a screenshot, compare with reference, and report findings.

say_en.text: Verify this terminal UI for text overflow or border misalignment.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the terminal output and check width and alignment.

say_en.text: Validate this component against the design system's color and spacing tokens.
say_en.note: Claude will review source code for reusable token usage.
